stages.title: The story path
stages.summary: Follow the named chapters and missions in campaign order; these entries give the guide its main spine. Keep optional cleanup visible as it unlocks, while the final mission waits for the endgame stage. Check off each named mission as it completes so the chapter trail stays clear beside optional work.

stages.title: Story opportunities
stages.summary: Keep these partner and story opportunities in view as you play, since some wording points to timing-sensitive moments. Catch Me If You Can, Actions Speak Louder, and Bad Luck, I Guess are flagged from the official descriptions; the game is new, so these are cautions, not confirmed lockouts. If a partner or choice opportunity appears, pause and resolve it before leaving that activity; no permanent lockout is verified.

stages.title: Strangers & characters
stages.summary: Work through character-specific mission strands as they become available, then count the broader stranger strands toward eight. Tracking each character’s finale here keeps the side story cleanup legible. Keep a simple list of finished character strands because the trophy wording does not provide a catalog.

stages.title: Activities & skill
stages.summary: Mix one-off activities with counted goals: 20 different races, 250 stunts, gold in every Shooting Range challenge, and 50 Challenges. The descriptions do not list every qualifying event or medal threshold, so use the game’s progress records and revisit unfinished entries. Log separate races and Shooting Range challenges as they register, then use the remaining totals to choose cleanup sessions.

stages.title: Collectibles & exploration
stages.summary: Pair exploration with the counted collections: meditate at every spot, use WAiNK at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles, register 10 with Scooter Bros, and complete three Collectible Card sets. The list gives no full catalog of spots or cards, so track game-recognized progress where available. Mark discoveries by category as you travel so spots, cards, and app registrations do not blur into one count.

stages.title: Crime & money
stages.summary: Keep repeated crime and money goals in separate counts: five Bank Vaults, an Armored Truck, one Illegal Operation for each gang, $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent across shops, and every garage property. The descriptions leave many locations and steps open, so record what the game recognizes. Track laundering and shop spending separately, and revisit the property list after new garages become available.

stages.title: Endgame
stages.summary: Close out the final mission and 100% completion after reviewing anything you still want to do. The platinum is the capstone for earning the rest of the list. Review remaining counters and the game’s own completion breakdown before treating the final mission as the last task.
